name: Urban Terror
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The free tactical shooter on the Quake III engine: capture the flag, bomb mode, team survivor and more. Installs any Urban Terror release, checked file by file against FrozenSand's checksums, and runs on ARM through Box64.
startup: b=; command -v box64 >/dev/null && b=box64; BOX64_LOG=0 exec $b ./Quake3-UrT-Ded.x86_64 +set fs_game q3ut4 +set fs_basepath /home/container +set fs_homepath /home/container +set dedicated 2 +set com_hunkmegs {{HUNKMEGS}} +set net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +exec server.cfg

config.files: {"q3ut4/server.cfg": {"parser": "file", "find": {"set  sv_hostname": "set  sv_hostname \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_NAME}}\"", "set  sv_joinmessage": "set  sv_joinmessage \"{{server.build.env.JOIN_MESSAGE}}\"", "set  sv_maxclients": "set  sv_maxclients \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_MAXCLIENTS}}\"", "set  rconpassword": "set  rconpassword \"{{server.build.env.RCON_PASSWORD}}\"", "set  g_password": "set  g_password \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_PASSWORD}}\"", "set  g_friendlyfire": "set  g_friendlyfire \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_FRIENDLYFIRE}}\"", "set  g_gametype": "set  g_gametype \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_GAMETYPE}}\"", "set  timelimit": "set  timelimit \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_TIMELIMIT}}\"", "map ": "map  \"{{server.build.env.SERVER_MAP}}\""}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Urban Terror. Installs the chosen Urban Terror release from FrozenSand's
# own update service, the way its updater does, checking every file against
# FrozenSand's checksums. Only files that changed are downloaded, and they
# replace the old ones only once all have arrived. server.cfg, mapcycle.txt
# and your own maps are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
api=https://www.urbanterror.info/api/updaterv4/
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/new"

# ask <query> <version id> <download server>: the service's answer, as XML.
ask() {
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -X POST -d platform=Linux64 -d "query=$1" -d password= -d "version=$2" \
        -d engine=1 -d "server=$3" -d updaterVersion=4.0.3 "$api"
}
info=$(ask versionInfo -1 -1) || fail "Urban Terror's update service can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# One "<id> <name>" line per release, newest first.
versions=$(tr -d '\r\n' <<<"$info" | grep -oE '<Version>.*</Version>' | sed 's#</Version>#&\n#g' |
    sed -nE 's#.*<VersionName>([^<]*)</VersionName><VersionNumber>([0-9]+)</VersionNumber>.*#\2 \1#p')
[ -n "$versions" ] || fail "Urban Terror's update service sent a release list this script can't read. Reinstall to try again later."
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    read -r id name < <(head -n 1 <<<"$versions")
else
    read -r id name < <(awk -v v="$want" '$2 == v { print; exit }' <<<"$versions") || true
    [ -n "${id:-}" ] || fail "Urban Terror has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to one of: $(awk '{ print $2 }' <<<"$versions" | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi
version=${name%% *}
# FrozenSand's download server.
srv=$(tr -d '\r\n' <<<"$info" | grep -oE '<Server>.*</Server>' | sed 's#</Server>#&\n#g' | sed -n 1p)
mirror=$(sed -nE 's#.*<ServerId>([0-9]+)</ServerId>.*#\1#p' <<<"$srv")
base=$(sed -nE 's#.*<ServerURL>([^<]*)</ServerURL>.*#\1#p' <<<"$srv")
[ -n "$mirror" ] && [ -n "$base" ] || fail "Urban Terror's update service listed no download server. Reinstall to try again later."

files=$(ask versionFiles "$id" "$mirror") || fail "Urban Terror's update service can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# One "<md5> <dir>/<name> <url>" line per file.
tr -d '\r\n' <<<"$files" | sed 's#</File>#&\n#g' | sed -nE 's#.*<File>(.*)</File>.*#\1#p' | while read -r f; do
    dir=$(sed -nE 's#.*<FileDir>([^<]*)</FileDir>.*#\1#p' <<<"$f")
    name=$(sed -nE 's#.*<FileName>([^<]*)</FileName>.*#\1#p' <<<"$f")
    md5=$(sed -nE 's#.*<FileMD5>([^<]*)</FileMD5>.*#\1#p' <<<"$f")
    url=$(grep -oE '<FileUrl>[^<]*</FileUrl>' <<<"$f" | tail -n 1 | sed -E 's#</?FileUrl>##g')
    case "$url" in http*) ;; *) url="${base%/}/$url" ;; esac
    printf '%s %s%s %s\n' "$md5" "$dir" "$name" "$url"
done > "$build/files"
[ -s "$build/files" ] || fail "Urban Terror's update service sent no files. Reinstall to try again later."

: > "$build/todo"
while read -r md5 path url; do
    case "$path" in /* | *..* | Quake3-UrT.*) continue ;; esac   # the game client isn't needed
    [ -n "$md5" ] || continue
    if [ ! -f "$path" ] || [ "$(md5sum "$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$md5" ]; then
        echo "$md5 $path $url" >> "$build/todo"
    fi
done < "$build/files"
total=$(wc -l < "$build/todo")
if [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Urban Terror $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Urban Terror $version ($total files)"
    while read -r md5 path url; do
        mkdir -p "$build/new/$(dirname "$path")"
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/new/$path" "$url" ||
            fail "The download of $path failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(md5sum "$build/new/$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$md5" ] ||
            fail "$path didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    done < "$build/todo"
    cp -a "$build/new/." .
fi
chmod +x Quake3-UrT-Ded.x86_64

# Starting settings, from the game's examples, only when there are none.
[ -f q3ut4/server.cfg ] || cp q3ut4/server_example.cfg q3ut4/server.cfg
[ -f q3ut4/mapcycle.txt ] || cp q3ut4/mapcycle_example.txt q3ut4/mapcycle.txt
echo "Installed Urban Terror $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Urban Terror release, such as 4.3.4, or latest for the newest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Join message
variables.description: The message players see when they join.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once; more than 24 causes problems.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Remote console password
variables.description: The password for the remote console (rcon). Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to start on, such as ut4_casa, ut4_turnpike or ut4_abbey.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: 0 free for all, 1 last man standing, 3 team deathmatch, 4 team survivor, 5 follow the leader, 6 capture and hold, 7 capture the flag, 8 bomb mode, 9 jump, 10 freeze tag, 11 gun game.

variables.name: Time limit
variables.description: Minutes before the map ends, or 0 for no limit.

variables.name: Friendly fire
variables.description: 0 off, 1 on and kick after too many team kills, 2 on without kicks.

variables.name: Memory
variables.description: Megabytes the game reserves for maps and models; raise it for big custom maps.
